basis.value_representation: Unmodified DuckDB CAST AS VARCHAR; SQL NULL is JSON null. Keys use the unchanged historical L0 normalization.

edits.old: and trim(status) in ('Open - Not Contacted', 'Working - Contacted', 'Closed - Converted', 'Closed - Not Converted')

edits.new: case when trim(status) in ('Open', 'Closed - Converted', 'Closed - Not Converted') then trim(status) else null end as status
case when annual_revenue<0 or annual_revenue>999999999999.99 then null else try_cast(annual_revenue as DECIMAL(18,2)) end
case when converted_date < DATE '1900-01-01' or converted_date > current_date + interval '1 year' or converted_date < created_date::DATE then null else try_cast(converted_date as TIMESTAMP) end
